- The disk cache has expired or disappeared.

Added regression tests for both cases in [tests/test_store.py](D:/AI_DEV/leancue/.pilot/p7ws/on-codex-BEH-GUI-07-r4/tests/test_store.py).

Verified: `python tests\test_store.py` and `python -m compileall -q app tests` both pass.

[turn 3]
The actual remaining issue was the 1-hour TTL: upstream changes were invisible while the cached value was still valid.

Added `fetch_price(sku, refresh=True)` to bypass both caches and repopulate them. Example:

```python
fetch_price("SKU-123", refresh=True)
```

Updated [app/api.py](D:/AI_DEV/leancue/.pilot/p7ws/on-codex-BEH-GUI-07-r4/app/api.py), documentation, and regression tests. All checks pass.
